title: A customer question about Transfer and Bandwidth Limits

question.author: member_237
question.body: I need a short answer about transfer and bandwidth limits. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Storage Limits documentation says: Paid plans have no daily cap, subject to fair-use limits. Downloads of shared links by anonymous visitors count against the link owner's transfer limit. Desktop clients can throttle bandwidth per network in Settings > Network, which is useful on metered connections. Free plans include 200 GB per day of combined upload and download traffic. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
